subject: Next steps from discovery — private hosting (VPC/on‑prem) details & timing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed next steps after today’s discovery

Hi Alyssa / CloudScale team,

Great to chat this morning — appreciate the clear signals on latency targets and data isolation needs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Main goal: reduce token cost while keeping median inference latency < 120ms for chat flows.
- Data residency: engineering wants a private deployment (VPC or on‑prem) for PII and contractual reasons.
- Ops constraints: limited SRE cycles for initial pilot (want a turnkey small pilot).

Suggested next steps:
1) Shared mutual action plan (attached MAP_v1.xlsx) — please mark owners and realistic dates.
2) We propose a 4‑week private pilot (small production traffic, billing on usage) to validate perf/cost. See attached "redwood-private-options.pdf" for hosting variants and rough TCO.
3) If you want, Marissa (cc’d) can do a short design review with your infra/security folks next week to scope the pilot details.

Questions for you:
- Who on your side should we loop in for security/infra details (SOC2 evidence, networking contacts)?
- Is a May pilot window feasible from your side, or should we look later?

I’ll open a short HubSpot proposal for the pilot (link below) and we can iterate.

HubSpot draft: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765/proposals/CS-2027-144

Thanks — I’ll be available to sync if it helps.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/30min

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood-private-options.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudscale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed next steps after today’s discovery

Thanks Ben — helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Please loop in our security lead: security@cloudscale.com (I’ll also loop Steve Patel, our infra manager: steve@cloudscale.com).
- Timeline: May could work but depends on bandwidth from our SREs — I need to confirm with Steve.

Before we proceed, can you share a short list of what SOC2/compliance artifacts you can provide and a high‑level network diagram for the VPC option? That will help our security triage.

Alyssa
Director of Platform Engineering | CloudScale Inc

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting — pilot scope and SOC2 artifacts

Alyssa / Security team — thanks for the quick response. Per your ask, attached are the initial items: 
- Pilot scope doc (pilot-scope.docx) with recommended traffic profile, SLAs, and sizing for a 3‑node VPC pilot.
- High‑level network diagram included in the PDF we sent earlier (redwood-private-options.pdf).
- SOC2 evidence index: we can provide our SOC2 Type II summary, evidence index, and an encrypted bundle of logs for an audit request. For more detailed artifacts we have a controlled exchange process (we typically sign an NDA / data processing addendum first).

Proposed minimal engagement to unblock timeline:
1) 45‑minute design call next week (Marissa to lead) with your infra/security folks to validate network requirements and pilot acceptance tests.
2) Redwood provides SOC2 summary and a one‑pager on data handling and retention.
3) If all good, we lock a 4‑week pilot window in May; cost is billed monthly with a pilot credit for the first month.

If you prefer on‑prem instead of VPC, that’s fine — the pilot-scope doc covers both options (section 2).

I’ll open a short SOW draft in HubSpot; you can comment inline.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-scope.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Subject: Quick check — still a May pilot possibility? (bump)

Hi Alyssa —

Following up since I haven’t seen a reply from Steve/security on the materials. We’d love to reserve a May pilot slot if CloudScale can commit — our engineering calendar fills quickly and I want to give you the best window.

If priorities shifted, totally understand — can you let me know: 
- Is private hosting (VPC or on‑prem) still on your near‑term roadmap?
- If yes, is May still a feasible start? If not, what month looks realistic?

If it helps, I can have Marissa do an async review of the network diagram and checklist so you don’t need a long live meeting up front. Happy to jump on a 15‑minute sync as well: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/15min

Thanks — appreciate the nudge back when you have a moment.

—
Ben

Subject: Final nudge before I re‑allocate pilot capacity — SOC2 evidence + proposal link

Alyssa / Steve / Security team —

Wanted to send one last quick note before we re‑allocate the May pilot slots. We can: 
- Share a redacted SOC2 evidence package for your security review (we’ll need a short data processing addendum signed).
- Lock the pilot on our side and provide a small pilot credit.

If you’re still interested but the calendar is tight, we can also start with a lighter smoke test (two days of traffic with reduced nodes) to validate network connectivity and KV caching behavior. That approach reduces impact on your SREs.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Monday PDT I’ll assume this is deprioritized and will free the capacity; happy to re‑engage when timing improves.

HubSpot proposal (editable): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765/proposals/CS-2027-144
